categories.main_business_segments: The company is a comprehensive industrial gas supplier specializing in the research, development, production, sales and service of high-purity gases. Main products include high-purity oxygen, high-purity nitrogen, high-purity argon, medical oxygen, food-grade nitrogen, industrial oxygen, carbon dioxide, hydrogen, various electronic gases and mixed gases. The company serves traditional industries such as metallurgy, chemicals, military, medical and food, as well as emerging industries including new energy, semiconductors, electronic information, biomedicine and new materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs air separation, physical purification, gas cylinder filling, and gas mixing processes to produce multiple types of gas products. Core technologies include residual gas and liquid recovery, vacuum pipeline application, anti-sway technology, energy recovery and comprehensive utilization, and liquid filling system safety. The company operates the largest full-liquid air separation gas production line in Southwest China and has mastered key production technologies and processes that have promoted the development and popularization of air separation gas production technology, particularly full-liquid air separation technology in China.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse customer base across multiple industries including metallurgy, chemicals, military, medical, food, machinery manufacturing, and emerging sectors such as photovoltaics, semiconductors, electronic information, biomedicine, and new materials. Core customers include listed companies such as Fujian Sangang Minlight Steel (002110), Tongwei Co., Ltd. (600438), Dongfang Electric (600875), Lier Chemical (002258), Shilan Micro (600460), CATL (300750), and Huayou Cobalt (603799), as well as major state-owned enterprises like Pangang Group and Baosteel Desheng.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Southwest China with major production bases in Sichuan Province (Dujiangyan, Wenchuan, Meishan, Jintang, and Deyang) and Fujian Province (Fuzhou). The company's main market is the Sichuan-Chongqing economic circle in Southwest China, with additional operations in Fujian and surrounding regions. The company has established a gas supply and service network covering the Southwest region and Fujian area.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the industrial gas supply chain. It produces industrial gases through air separation and related processes, then supplies these gases directly to end-use customers through multiple distribution channels including pipeline gas, liquid gas, and bottled gas. The company also engages in some upstream equipment manufacturing through subsidiary Sichuan Jiuyuan Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is to establish itself as a leading industrial gas supplier in Southwest China while expanding nationally. Key R&D initiatives include developing high-purity special gases, expanding electronic gas products, exploring hydrogen as a clean energy source, and improving energy efficiency through technologies like residual gas recovery and energy recovery systems. The company aims to deepen penetration in emerging industries such as new energy, semiconductors, and new materials while maintaining leadership in traditional markets.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of industrial gas products using three main supply models: liquid gas sales, pipeline gas supply (on-site production for specific customers), and bottled gas sales. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the gas products, typically upon delivery or pickup. The company also generates supplementary revenue from equipment rental and logistics services. The company maintains long-term supply contracts with major customers, providing stable and predictable revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both international and domestic gas suppliers. International competitors include Linde, Air Liquide, Praxair (now part of Linde), and Messer. Domestic competitors include professional gas suppliers like Yingde Gas and Heyuan Gas, as well as upstream equipment manufacturers like Hangyang Co., Ltd. that have expanded downstream. The company positions itself as the leading full-liquid air separation gas supplier in Southwest China with significant competitive advantages in the Sichuan-Chongqing region.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized industrial gas producer with 2023 revenue of approximately 1.022 billion yuan, representing 11.25% growth from 2022 revenue of 918.4 million yuan. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 202.75 million yuan in 2023, up 72.77% from 117.35 million yuan in 2022. The company has demonstrated consistent growth with operating cash flow of 150.4 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 2.002 billion yuan at year-end 2023, with shareholders' equity of 1.722 billion yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through superior product quality, regional market leadership, and comprehensive service capabilities. Key value propositions include: (1) highest quality products meeting national standards with stable quality recognized by major customers; (2) largest full-liquid air separation production capacity in Southwest China providing reliable supply; (3) cost advantages from large-scale production and low-cost hydroelectric power in Wenchuan; (4) professional logistics network with 100+ vehicles enabling 300km same-day delivery; (5) comprehensive one-stop service including equipment provision, maintenance, and technical support; and (6) deep customer relationships built over 20+ years with major industrial and emerging technology companies.
